## Targeting

- Primary: Staff Backend Engineer
- Secondary: Staff Platform Engineer
- Stretch: Principal Software Engineer at a smaller company
- Industries to favor: developer tools, climate software, financial infrastructure, healthcare infrastructure
- Location posture: remote in the United States or New York City hybrid, at most two office days per week
- Target base: $230,000
- Minimum base: $200,000

## Keep signals

- Hands-on architecture and implementation
- Distributed systems, data platforms, or developer infrastructure
- Technical leadership without mandatory direct reports
- Explicit reliability or scale problems
- Strong engineering writing and mentorship culture

## Cut signals

- Five days per week onsite
- Pure people-management roles
- Roles centered on ad targeting, weapons, or employee surveillance
- Base compensation below $200,000
- On-call expectations described as permanently understaffed or hero-driven

## Evidence and honesty boundaries

- Morgan led technical direction for an eight-engineer platform group but did not have performance-management responsibility.
- Morgan designed Kubernetes deployment standards and operated production clusters, but did not build Kubernetes controllers or contribute upstream.
- The 1.8 billion events/day figure belongs only to Juniper Relay.
- The 31% infrastructure-cost reduction was measured over two quarters and was shared work with FinOps; phrase as "co-led."
- Morgan has production Go, Python, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Kafka, AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform experience.
- Morgan has no production Rust experience, no ML model-training experience, no security clearance, and no patents.
- Do not inflate "technical lead" into "engineering manager" or claim direct reports.

## Interview story seeds

- Reliability: led a Kafka partitioning and backpressure redesign that reduced p99 event latency from 220 ms to 78 ms while traffic doubled.
